Omar (Product): Heads-up: GTM asked for a compact "Finance Observability" pilot. Must-haves they listed: exportable chargeback CSVs, route->trace linking for audits, error fingerprint table with RCA tags, and a shareable finance dashboard template. We only have 2 engineers half-time. Let's negotiate scope.

Leah (Eng-Observability): From infra side: lowest-effort path is aggregated metrics + an index to sampled traces. Error fingerprinting can run in the pipeline as a lightweight post-process (hash stack trace + normalized prompt). Full per-invocation cost attribution touches runtime and billing.

Ben (Eng-Runtime): To produce exact per-invocation cost we need deterministic token accounting post-quantization + idempotent writes for retries. That's a runtime change and will need coordination with billing. Not small.

Ruth (GTM): Sales will accept Preview if we label it and offer a clear migration path. They want to demo something tangible to finance teams next month. Template dashboard is high impact.

Omar (Product): Proposed split: Pilot (hosted preview) = aggregated per-route CSVs (marked ESTIMATED), trace linking (sampled), fingerprint table with sample traces and RCA tags. GA (dedicated/private) = audited per-invocation numbers, reconciliation job, downloadable audited CSV. Agree?

Leah (Eng-Observability): Agree in principle. Implementation notes:
- Aggregated CSV: store route, time-window, tokens_est, cost_est, confidence_pct, note=ESTIMATED.
- Trace linking: maintain route -> recent_sampled_trace_ids index. Sampling policy important.
- Fingerprinting: normalize variable fields before hashing; add RCA tags (e.g., "model_timeout", "prompt_truncation", "runtime_oom").

Ben (Eng-Runtime): For the GA audit flow we need: 1) per-request token delta emitted from runtime after final output, 2) atomic attach of trace_id + cost to billing row, 3) nightly reconcile that flags discrepancies. Ballpark 4 sprints cross-team.

Ruth (GTM): Can we commit to a short pilot script: show dashboard template, export CSV (estimated), click through to 5 sampled traces, and show fingerprint RCA table? If so Sales can demo.

Omar (Product): Acceptance criteria for Pilot:
- UI: "Finance Kit" page with route selector, default top-15, time range, export CSV button.
- CSV columns: [route, start_ts, end_ts, tokens_est, cost_est, confidence_pct, note].
- Trace linking: clicking a route opens sampled traces (min 3 when available).
- Fingerprint view: top 20 fingerprints, count, first_seen, sample_trace_id, RCA tag.
- Docs: clear "Estimated hosted numbers" language + migration playbook.

Leah (Eng-Observability): Sampling policy suggestion: adaptive sampling that increases capture rate for errors and high est_cost outliers. Pseudocode we used in spike:
```
if is_error or est_cost > p90: sample_rate = 0.1 else sample_rate = 0.01
```
This keeps storage bounded.

Ben (Eng-Runtime): We should also emit model_version and batching_mode fields to help correlate estimator drift. And avoid exposing PII in exported CSVs.

Omar (Product): Gating for GA: reconciliation tests pass for 4 weeks on staging, billing pipeline signoff, and legal/compliance review. If any fail, GA delayed.

Ruth (GTM): Need one-pager wording: "Pilot = estimated numbers for hosted; Dedicated = audited billing and exports." I'll prepare and iterate.

ops-bot: Created ticket FINOBS-12: "finance-observability pilot: aggregated CSVs + trace links + fingerprints" assigned to eng-observability, eng-runtime. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FINOBS-12

Omar (Product): Next steps: Leah/Ben do a 3-day spike for estimator accuracy and sampling config (deliverable: short doc + sample CSV), Ruth to line up 2 pilot customers, I'll draft the acceptance checklist for PM sync Friday.

Leah (Eng-Observability): I'll include retention/infra cost estimates in the spike.

Ben (Eng-Runtime): I'll scope runtime changes needed for GA and flag owners.

Omar (Product): Thanks all. If spikes look good we aim to start pilot rollout in 3 weeks. :rocket:
